نترابط (form VI)
# نَتَرَابَطُ (natarābaṭu) /na.ta.raː.ba.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَابَطَ (tarābaṭa)
# نَتَرَابَطَ (natarābaṭa) /na.ta.raː.ba.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَابَطَ (tarābaṭa)
# نَتَرَابَطْ (natarābaṭ) /na.ta.raː.batˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَابَطَ (tarābaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
